criteria.text: Page title / heading is the locations / auction-sites directory (heading Locations). Intro text is visible and states that Ritchie Bros. offers over 60 permanent auction sites and local yards.
Copy explaining that satellite sites are marked with an asterisk * is visible.

Scroll below the map. Country names are h4 headings above each site list (first two are United States and Canada). Count those headings. The list must include at least: United States, Canada, Australia, United Kingdom, Netherlands, UAE.
Count the US locations. The count must be greater than 20. The list must include Phoenix, Salt Lake City, Houston, Las Vegas, and Atlanta.
Count the Canadian locations. The count must be greater than 10. The list must include Edmonton, Montreal, Toronto, Regina, and Saskatoon.

Count locations marked with * (satellite) and locations not marked (permanent) on the full directory. Satellite count must be greater than 15. Permanent count must be greater than 25. Combined total must be greater than 60.
San Antonio and Calgary, AB appear with an asterisk. Phoenix and Edmonton appear without an asterisk.
Both controls are available. Switching to Local representatives changes the content (shows "Search for representatives").
Edmonton is listed under Canada and is not marked as a satellite.
Browser opens the Edmonton yard page. URL contains /lp/edmonton-ab (or the equivalent slug the site uses). Page heading / location name is Edmonton.
Address is shown and includes 1500 Sparrow Drive, Nisku, AB, and postal code T9E 8H6. Office hours are shown and include Mon - Fri and a time range. A telephone number is shown.

The Auction events heading is visible (below Details). Count the event cards. Count must be at least 1. Each card has a date range (for example Sep 22 - Sep 25) and a title (for example Edmonton, AB, CAN).
Section is visible and non-empty. Text mentions that the yard is open on weekdays for drop-off, inspection, and pick-up.

This is the Items in yard carousel (not the auction-event cards). Count all category cards in the carousel, including slides that are off-screen — do not count only the 3–4 visible tiles. Count must be greater than 5. Each card has a name and a quantity like N items. The carousel includes Excavators and at least one of Harvesting Equipment, Agricultural Tractors, Sprayers, or Excavator Attachments.
"Become a seller" form is visible and has a phone number. Do not submit the form.
Open the Representatives tab. At least one representative card is shown, with a territory / region and at least one of: phone, mobile, email.
A search / inventory view opens. The query or location context is Edmonton.

Read the result total from the page — it appears as 2.2k results for "Edmonton" (top of the list) and/or 1-60 of 2290 (bottom of the first page). The exact number changes; parse whatever total is shown. Do not count lots by iterating cards. The displayed total must be greater than 0. Each lot visible on the first page has a title. Where a location or closing/auction date is shown on the card, it is non-empty. Log the displayed total and the first 5 titles to the console.
Payload is JSON and includes a list of yards/locations.
Count of locations is greater than 60.
Each location has a name and a country (name or code).
The list includes Edmonton (Canada / CAN) and Phoenix (United States / USA).
Each location has a site type (Satellite or Permanent). Count of satellite locations is greater than 15. Count of permanent locations is greater than 25.
Count of distinct countries is greater than 8 and includes United States and Canada.
Payload is JSON.
Yard name is Edmonton. Address includes 1500 Sparrow Drive, Nisku, and T9E 8H6. A phone number and pickup/office hours are present.
Count upcoming events. If the yard has upcoming events, count is at least 1. Each event has a start/end date (or date range) and a name. At least one event refers to Edmonton or Nisku.

Count equipment categories in itemsInYard (flatten the nested category lists). Count is greater than 5. Each category has a name (categoryLocalized). Quantities (totalAssets), when present, are numbers ≥ 0. The list includes Excavators.
Response is HTTP 200 and JSON.
Read results.totalAmount (or the field the API uses for the full hit count). It must be greater than 0. Do not page through every lot.
The first page of records is non-empty. Each record has a display name in assetDescription (there is no title field).
Log the total count and the first 5 titles to the console.
